text: .177. In B. divergens infections, treatment is complicated by the rapid progression of the disease. Anti- protozoal and antimalarial drugs have been tried with lim- ited success, although pentamidine with co-trimoxazole was successful in a patient,11 and a marked reduction in parasite load was seen in a patient treated with pentami- dine plus exchange transfusions.12 The combination of clindamycin plus quinine with exchange transfusion has also been suggested.2 Preventive measures against babesiosis include the use of tick repellents, physical protection, and prompt removal of attached ticks.1 1.
